description: The Mirabello Investment Migration Index — a composite 0–100 ranking of CBI/RBI programmes across cost, mobility, speed, path-to-citizenship, stability, family and tax, with transparent published methodology. Filter by type (CBI/RBI) and limit. Returns the TOP 25 by default (the full table is large); pass limit for more, or limit:0 for every ranked programme. Programmes with insufficient verified data are flagged provisional and excluded from the headline ranking.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return. Responses can be large; use this to keep the answer small.

type.description: Programme family: "CBI" grants citizenship, "RBI" grants residence (golden visa). Omit for both.

name: get_index

outputSchema.description: Mirabello envelope; tool fields vary; error only on failure.

title: Investment Migration Index
